---
title: "Metagenomic Sequencing — Total Bases per Sample"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read_tsv("all_samples_total_bases.tsv") %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract CH number and group from bpm_sample
    ch_num = str_extract(bpm_sample, "CH0[1-6]"),
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(bpm_sample, "BFBB") ~ str_replace(bpm_sample, ".*_(ASC|EVI)_BFBB", "\\1_CAT"),
      str_detect(bpm_sample, "RVS")  ~ str_replace(bpm_sample, ".*_(ASC|EVI)_RVS", "\\1_RVS"),
      str_detect(bpm_sample, "ASC")  ~ "ASC",
      str_detect(bpm_sample, "EVI")  ~ "EVI"
    ),
    # Friendly label using abricate_sample name
    label = abricate_sample,
    # Order: group first, then CH number
    label = fct_reorder2(label, group, ch_num)
  )
```

## Total bases per sample (log₁₀ scale)

```{r plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
group_colours <- c(
  "ASC"     = "#4E79A7",
  "ASC_CAT" = "#A0CBE8",
  "ASC_RVS" = "#1F4F78",
  "EVI"     = "#F28E2B",
  "EVI_CAT" = "#FFBE7D",
  "EVI_RVS" = "#B35900"
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = total_bases, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = scales::label_log(digits = 2),
    breaks = 10^(4:10)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values  = group_colours,
    name    = "Sample group",
    labels  = c(
      "ASC"     = "ASC (raw)",
      "ASC_CAT" = "ASC concatenated",
      "ASC_RVS" = "ASC reverse",
      "EVI"     = "EVI (raw)",
      "EVI_CAT" = "EVI concatenated",
      "EVI_RVS" = "EVI reverse"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "Total sequencing bases per metagenomic sample",
    x       = NULL,
    y       = "Total bases (log₁₀ scale)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    legend.position  = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )
```

```{r summary-table}
df %>%
  select(Sample = abricate_sample, Group = group, `Total bases` = total_bases) %>%
  mutate(`Total bases` = scales::comma(`Total bases`)) %>%
  knitr::kable(align = c("l", "l", "r"), caption = "Total bases per sample")
```
